name.en: Oblique s/p incidence on a Lorentz-dispersive slab

caption.ja: 保存したp偏光の実電場をky=4の周期y方向へ再構成した場。 周期y方向の1周期を表示しています。波形を見やすくするため、x軸とy軸の表示縮尺は異なります。
caption.en: Actual saved p-polarized electric field reconstructed over the periodic y direction at ky=4. One transverse y period is shown. The displayed x and y scales differ to make the fields visible.

formula: \partial_t\mathbf P=\mathbf J,\quad\partial_t\mathbf J=f\mathbf E-\omega_0^2\mathbf P-\gamma\mathbf J,\quad f=\Delta\varepsilon\omega_0^2

note.ja: 正の物質エネルギーと直接Ohmic/γ仕事を持つ単一受動Lorentz極。代表式は3Dですが、実装は周期y単一kyの2D s/p成分制限です。PML数値仕事は物理散逸と同一視しません。
note.en: A single passive Lorentz pole with positive material energy and direct Ohmic/gamma work. The representative equations are three-dimensional; the implemented solver is the two-dimensional s/p component restriction at one periodic ky. Numerical PML work is not identified with physical dissipation.

equation_note.ja: 周期y方向のky=4に制限した2D場、c=1。板[4,5]のε∞=1.5、Δε=0.75、ω0=9、γ=0.5、σ=0.04。外側は真空、PEC端は[-24,36]、T=60です。
equation_note.en: Use a two-dimensional field restricted to periodic transverse wave number ky = 4 and c = 1. The slab [4, 5] has epsilon_inf = 1.5, delta_epsilon = 0.75, omega_0 = 9, gamma = 0.5 and sigma = 0.04. Outer vacuum ends at PEC caps [-24, 36]; T = 60.

name.en: Oblique s/p incidence on a Lorentz-dispersive slab

latex: \varepsilon_\infty\partial_t\mathbf E=\nabla\times\mathbf H-\sigma\mathbf E-\mathbf J,\quad\partial_t\mathbf P=\mathbf J

note.ja: 有限波束の実進行から複素r/t・R/T・直接散逸を求め、複素Fresnel参照と比較します。
note.en: Measure complex r/t, power fractions and direct dissipation from actual finite-pulse evolutions and compare them with complex Fresnel slab references.

title.ja: 斜め入射の複素Fresnel係数とLorentz板の直接散逸
title.en: Complex oblique Fresnel coefficients and direct Lorentz-slab loss

assumptions.en: Vacuum surroundings, ky = 4, slab [4, 5], epsilon_inf = 1.5, delta_epsilon = 0.75, omega_0 = 9, gamma = 0.5 and sigma = 0.04. Compare omega = 5.1/6/6.9 for both s = Ez and p = Hz.

note.ja: 任意の横方向分布ではなく単一kyの実空間制限です。1つの受動Lorentz極と有限帯域・有限窓のみ。Gaussian尾は厳密には非零で、窓診断と参照誤差を別記します。 全周波数で厳密にcap反射が未到達という証明ではありません。
note.en: This is a genuine single-ky restriction rather than arbitrary transverse data. It covers one passive Lorentz pole and a fixed finite band/window. Gaussian tails are nonzero; window diagnostics and reference errors are reported separately. No strict all-frequency no-return proof is claimed.

reference_note.ja: s/p各3解像度の物質・真空12進行からω=5.1/6/6.9を測定。独立な有限窓の真空幾何級数、複素Fresnel係数、直接体積散逸、全stepのPEC収支と末尾を検査します。
reference_note.en: Measure omega = 5.1/6/6.9 from 12 actual material/vacuum evolutions across three resolutions and both polarizations. Check an independent finite-window vacuum geometric sum, complex Fresnel coefficients, direct volume dissipation, all-step PEC budgets and final monitor tails.

method_note.ja: 単一ky Yee空間演算と局所の陰的中点Lorentz ADE。p偏光の両電場に分極を結合し、同格子の真空波束で入射・伝播位相を除きます。直接Ohmic・物質減衰仕事と修正エネルギーを別々に集計します。
method_note.en: Use the single-ky Yee spatial operator and local implicit-midpoint Lorentz ADE. Couple both p-polarized electric components to polarization, and remove incident propagation with a matched vacuum pulse on the same grid. Accumulate direct Ohmic and material-damping work separately from modified energy.
